name: Pilates Ring Chest Press
description: Standing tall with the ring between your palms and your arms straight out at chest height, squeeze the ring, hold, and release slowly.
setup: Hold the ring between your palms, arms straight in front at chest height.
cues: Shoulders down, away from your ears.

prescription.note: Squeeze for a breath, then release slowly without letting the ring spring back.

keyframes.name: Hold the ring
keyframes.cue: Arms straight in front at chest height, the ring between your palms.

keyframes.name: Squeeze
keyframes.cue: Press your palms together to squeeze the ring; arms stay straight.
